note: Signature abilities (career and the daily challenge; off in ranked and friendly until balance sims are clean). trigger = when it fires, effect = what changes, magnitude = how much (0.1 = 10%), duration in seconds (0 = that shot), cooldown in seconds. Never changes net-fault rules or the net-kill/net-spin thresholds. from_sheet = numbers from the owner's roster sheet. 5.0: tiers S (Signature), SS (Special Signature), SSS (Superstar Signature: narrow triggers, big effects) and U (Ultra Signature, Champions only; trigger "ultra" = not built into matches yet).

abilities.name: Counterstrike
abilities.text: A perfectly timed defensive shot goes 5% faster.

abilities.name: Relentless Pursuit
abilities.text: After a successful retrieval, 8% faster movement for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Iron Formation
abilities.text: After a successful block, the opponent’s smashes are 10% slower for 2 seconds (never below the game’s smash floor).

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.text: Below 30% Rested, your Rested penalty (timing, movement and aim) is halved.

abilities.name: False Opening
abilities.text: Drops, net shots and flicks have a 7% better chance of wrong-footing the opponent. Wrong-footed players stop for 0.2 s.

abilities.name: Silk Touch
abilities.text: Net shots are 12% more precise.

abilities.name: Net Dominance
abilities.text: After winning a point at the net, the next attacking shot is 10% faster (smashes stay within the game’s limit).

abilities.name: Phantom Rhythm
abilities.text: Changing shot type from your last shot gives a 9% chance of wrong-footing the opponent. Wrong-footed players stop for 0.2 s.

abilities.name: Early Pressure
abilities.text: Attacking shots taken early (within 0.6 s of the opponent’s shot) are 8% faster.

abilities.name: Unbreakable Guard
abilities.text: After a successful block, the opponent’s next smash is 10% slower (never below the game’s smash floor).

abilities.name: Crosscourt Flick

abilities.name: Great Wall
abilities.text: All of Chen Long's lifts go to the very back of the court and are always in. After a lift, Chen Long goes into a defensive stance: his reach is 25% bigger for the next shot. His blocks are much less likely to fail to get over the net.

abilities.name: Untouchable
abilities.text: Once 3 net shots have been played in a rally (by either player), Kento Momota's next net shot always tumbles. He never touches the net on net kills, and he can net kill and net tap tighter net shots than his opponents can.

abilities.name: Fastest of All Time
abilities.text: After a successful smash, Lee Chong Wei moves 40% faster, so he can reach tight blocks close to the net. After a successful net shot, he moves 50% faster getting back to the back court.

abilities.name: The GOAT
abilities.text: Every attacking shot Lin Dan plays in a row (drives, smashes, drops, net kills, net taps) boosts his power, accuracy and speed by 7.5%. The boost resets when he has to play a defensive or neutral shot (lifts, clears, net shots).

abilities.name: King of Backhand
abilities.text: Shots on Taufik Hidayat's backhand side have 30% more power and are 50% more accurate. He can play backhand smashes, at 85% of his forehand smash power.

abilities.name: Denmark's Pride
abilities.text: Smashes have 20% more power and need perfect timing to defend, by block or lift. A defence without perfect timing leaves the opponent stunned for 1 second, unable to move. A mistimed defence goes to half court or high at the net 90% of the time.
